0.reason: script-only duplication (git-archive extraction in mutant.py and suite.py); product reuse is closed (greens, section_nodes); folded into the scripts cleanup with the WEST source-recipe copy

findings.text: extract() duplicates the git-archive extraction that scripts/west_iron_galerkin/suite.py:25-53 already owns: same tempfile.mkdtemp under TMPDIR, same 'git archive' Popen, same tar.extractall(filter='data'), and the identical five-path set at mutant.py:19 and suite.py:43-47. The node removed the duplication in the mutation half and left it in the extraction half, so a change to the extraction set still has to be made in two places.

The fragment states 'A change to the extraction set or to the identity guard is made once', but the extraction set is carried in mutant.py:19 ARCHIVE_PATHS and again inline at suite.py:43-47, so the sentence overstates what the factoring achieved and a reader who trusts it will edit one copy only.

The carrier guard is a standalone script with no caller anywhere in tests/ or conftest.py, so a regression that re-adds a second mutant program fails no suite and is caught only if someone runs duplication.py by hand; its own demonstration in reuse-negative-control.log shows it can fail, but nothing schedules it.
